column1: # gc_wsb_producers.tsv -- THE AUDIT OF THE HB_WSB AND HB_WSC PRODUCERS BY ALLOCATION SITE (hq_runtime, ceo-2030; ARCH-GC-COMPILE-TIME-FRAME-MAPS 13.14 second sitting (3)(c)).
# WHAT THE CLASSES MEAN. HB_WSB and HB_WSC carry bytes: a payload that holds no pointer into the collected heap (a pointer to a slab region, the compile-time arena, a code address, a static
# table or libc memory is not one). util_wsb_producer_audit.py reads every producer in SCRIP/src (rt_wsb_alloc, rt_wsb_realloc, rt_heap_alloc_c, the RX_ALLOC and RX_REALLOC macros,
# rt_gcheap_grow_block, gv_push and gv_reserve with a WSB or WSC kind) and calls a site BYTES by itself when its destination is a one-level pointer to char, int, unsigned, size_t, long
# long or a fixed-width integer. Every other site must have a row here, and every row must still match a site; test_gate_gc_wsb_wsc_producers_are_pointer_free.sh is red on a site with no
# row and on a row with no site. A payload that does carry a collected-heap pointer is NOT a row here: it has a typed class (HB_NVAR, HB_FNCB, HB_DATB, HB_EVCH, HB_LBLT, HB_IOCH,
# HB_TRCE, HB_PROC, or the existing HB_DVEC and HB_PVEC) and a validator row in gc_slot_table.c.
# COLUMNS: file (under SCRIP/src)  |  a substring of the producer's line  |  BYTES or TRANSIENT  |  why.
# BYTES: no collected-heap pointer in the payload, whatever the destination type looks like.
# TRANSIENT: the payload is a graph of WSB blocks that point at each other, built and used inside one runtime call that reaches no safe point, so no collection finds it live; it is a
# DECLARED LIMIT of this audit (the validator cannot see such a block as typed), reported to the cto, and a row here is removed the day the producer is typed or moved to the stack.

That is measured, not asserted: arm (4) of test_gate_gc_wsb_wsc_producers_are_pointer_free.sh reads the built runtime's call graph (util_wsb_transient_reach.py) and is red the day an rx.c symbol or the RxEnv callback reaches a collection entry or a dispatcher by any route but the allocator's no-return out-of-memory exit; from that day these rows become typed rows with a validator row.
